public_boundary_es: El envío, la ausencia de rebote y la conservación del hilo no prueban lectura personal por cada destinatario. El silencio no se interpreta por sí solo como infracción.
public_boundary_en: Sending, absence of a bounce and preservation of the thread do not prove personal reading by each recipient. Silence is not treated by itself as evidence of an infringement.
private_source_rule: Native Gmail message/thread identifiers and full private transport metadata remain outside public Git.
